dashboard.label: Detection Engineering
dashboard.description: Detection coverage based on the exported IDS, Windows, SMB, and process telemetry lookups.

search.query: | inputlookup alert_severity.csv | rename "alert.severity" AS severity | chart sum(count) AS detections by severity
| inputlookup attack_maj_category.csv | rename "alert.category" AS category | eval category=if(category="", "Unclassified", category) | sort - count | head 10
| inputlookup Top_IDS_Signatures.csv | rename "alert.signature" AS signature | sort - count | head 10
| inputlookup Most_Attacked.csv | stats count AS alerts by dest_ip | sort - alerts | head 10
| inputlookup Windows_Logons.csv | eval identity=host . " / " . Account_Name | chart sum(count) AS logons by identity | sort - logons | head 10
| inputlookup SMB_Activity.csv | sort - count | head 20 | rename src_ip AS "Source IP", dest_ip AS "Destination IP", count AS Connections

| inputlookup share_accessed__.csv | eval evidence_type="Share accessed", subject=Share_Name | fields evidence_type subject count | append [| inputlookup hosts_inv_shares.csv | eval evidence_type="Host inventory", subject=host . " → " . Share_Name | fields evidence_type subject count] | append [| inputlookup prilaged_access.csv | eval evidence_type="Privileged access", subject=Account_Name . " @ " . host | fields evidence_type subject count] | sort - count | rename evidence_type AS "Evidence type", subject AS Subject, count AS Events

| inputlookup CMD_sus.csv | table _time host Account_Name New_Process_Name Process_Command_Line Creator_Process_Name | rename _time AS Time, host AS Host, Account_Name AS Account, New_Process_Name AS "New process", Process_Command_Line AS "Command line", Creator_Process_Name AS "Parent process" | head 50

| inputlookup php-cgi_sus.csv | table _time host Account_Name New_Process_Name Process_Command_Line ComputerName | rename _time AS Time, host AS Host, Account_Name AS Account, New_Process_Name AS "New process", Process_Command_Line AS "Command line", ComputerName AS Computer | head 50
